name: create_architecture_views_summary
description:
Create comprehensive markdown summary of all architectural views from current session.

Scans the exports directory for all generated diagrams and creates a unified summary document with:
- Links to all successful architectural views
- Diagram metadata and statistics
- Session overview with timestamps
- Optional inclusion of failed attempts for debugging

Useful for:
- Documentation of complete architecture modeling sessions
- Portfolio overview of generated views
- Sharing multiple diagrams with stakeholders
- Project documentation and handoffs

summary_filename.description: Name for the summary markdown file (auto-generated if not provided)

include_failed_attempts.description: Whether to include failed diagram attempts in summary for debugging
